faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Dubai Healthcare City Free Zone.

items.a: DHCC is the world's largest free zone dedicated to healthcare and wellness, located in Dubai. It's home to 500+ healthcare partners including hospitals, clinics, pharmacies, labs, and medical education institutions.

items.q: Who can open a business in DHCC?
items.a: Physicians, surgeons, pharmacists, diagnostic labs, mental health professionals, dental practices, medical researchers, nursing services, health-tech companies, and medical educators can establish in DHCC.

items.q: What licenses are available in DHCC?
items.a: Medical License, Pharmaceutical License, Diagnostic & Lab License, Professional License, HealthTech License, and Education License.

items.q: Do I need DHA approval to operate in DHCC?
items.a: Yes. Healthcare practitioners and facilities require Dubai Health Authority (DHA) licensing and regulatory approval, which we help you obtain.

items.q: How long does it take to set up in DHCC?
items.a: Typically 3-5 working days for company setup, and 4-8 weeks for full DHA healthcare licensing depending on the activity.

items.q: Can I get 100% foreign ownership in DHCC?
items.a: Yes. DHCC allows 100% foreign ownership — no local sponsor required.

items.q: What are the tax benefits of DHCC?
items.a: 0% corporate and personal income tax with full repatriation of profits and capital.

items.q: What support does Setup Zone Dubai provide for DHCC?
items.a: We handle license application, DHA approval, trade name reservation, document preparation, visas, bank account opening, and ongoing compliance.

items.q: Do I need medical qualifications to open a healthcare business in DHCC?
items.a: Yes for clinical activities — medical degrees, licenses, and DHA eligibility are required. Non-clinical activities may have different requirements.

items.q: What office options are available in DHCC?
items.a: Flexi-desks, executive offices, clinics, labs, and purpose-built medical facilities depending on your business type.
